In [ ]:






import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

data_crosstab = pd.DataFrame({
    'WiFi_Yes': [50, 30], # Weekend, Weekday
    'WiFi_No': [20, 80]
}, index=['Weekend', 'Weekday'])

chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(data_crosstab)

print(f"Chi-Square Statistic: {chi2:.4f}")
print(f"P-value: {p:.4f}")

if p < 0.05:
    print("Variables are related")
else:
    print("Variables are independent")





















In [ ]:






import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Contingency table 
# Row 1: WiFi Yes (Weekend, Weekday)
# Row 2: WiFi No (Weekend, Weekday)
data = [[30, 20], 
        [10, 40]]

chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(data)

print("Chi-square:", chi2)
print("P-value:", p)

if p < 0.05:
    print("Variables are associated")
else:
    print("No association")

In [ ]:






import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind


df = pd.read_csv('flight_data.csv')


df['weekend'] = df['weekend'].map({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0})

weekend_price = df[df['weekend'] == 1]['coach_price']
weekday_price = df[df['weekend'] == 0]['coach_price']

t_stat, p_value = ttest_ind(weekend_price, weekday_price)

print("T-test p-value:", p_value)

if p_value < 0.05:
    print("Price difference is significant")
else:
    print("No significant price difference")

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
# Independent variable
X = flight[['miles']]

# Dependent variable
y = flight['coach_price']

# Create model
model = LinearRegression()

# Fit model
model.fit(X, y)

# Regression coefficients
print("Intercept:", model.intercept_)
print("Slope:", model.coef_[0])

# Predicted values
y_pred = model.predict(X)                                                                              # Scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(7,5))

plt.scatter(flight['miles'], flight['coach_price'])

plt.plot(flight['miles'], y_pred)

plt.xlabel("Miles")
plt.ylabel("Coach Price")
plt.title("Regression: Miles vs Coach Price")

plt.show()

from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None 

questions = [
    "1. How many flights are classified as weekend flights versus weekday flights?",
    "2. Is there a significant correlation between the miles flown and the coach_price?",
    "3. How much more expensive, on average, is firstclass_price compared to coach_price?",
    "4. Does the presence of inflight_meal or inflight_wifi impact the ticket price?",
    "5. What is the average price of a redeye flight compared to a non-redeye flight?",
    "6. What percentage of flights offer all three amenities?",
    "7. Are longer flights (hours > 5) more likely to provide inflight_entertainment?",
    "8. Which amenity is the most commonly offered across all flights?",
    "9. Does the number of passengers on a flight correlate with the length of the delay?",
    "10. Can we reject the null hypothesis of equal coach_price (Sat vs Wed) via T-test?",
    "11. Can we build a linear regression model to predict firstclass_price based on miles/hours?"
]


file_name = 'yc-siu-FuRsB1qFJSU-unsplash.jpg'
img = Image.open(file_name)


plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))

plt.subplot(2, 1, 1) 
plt.imshow(img)
plt.axis('off')
plt.title("Flight Data Analysis Visualization", fontsize=15, pad=10)


plt.subplot(2, 1, 2) 
plt.axis('off') 


y_pos = 1.0
for q in questions:
    plt.text(0.0, y_pos, q, fontsize=11, family='serif')
    y_pos -= 0.1 

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
